name: Giant Eagle
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 235 in v2, Giant Eagle Traits.
heading: Giant Eagle Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The printed flight trait gives 60 ft. The 80 ft. figure in the design notes on p. 236 does not govern this profile.

name: Giant Frog
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 236–237 in v2, Giant Frog Traits.
heading: Giant Frog Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The heading starts on p. 236. The trait continuation on p. 237 grants neither Standing Leap nor Darkvision, despite both being named in the design notes.

Silt uses the bite as the physical grip for the species' bonus-action grapple. The ordinary size limit, reach, and Athletics contest still apply. Dexterity can govern the bite, while the grapple still uses Strength.

name: Giant Hyena
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 238 in v2, Giant Hyena Traits.
heading: Giant Hyena Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The printable trait gives 30 ft. walk speed. The design notes discuss 40 ft. and suggest Pack Tactics as an optional change. Neither applies to the printed player profile.

name: Giant Octopus
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 239–240 in v2, Giant Octopus Traits.
heading: Giant Octopus Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The published trait includes no automatic grab or restraint rider on the tentacle attack, although the design notes discuss Grab.
Ink Cloud omits its activation timing. Dunewick uses an action for the release as a table ruling, consistent with the encounter ability that inspired it.
For Martial Arts, Kamstra's p. 7 uses the monk damage die for the bonus-action strike rather than the species' larger natural damage die.
